documentation:
# LineChart

## Overview

The LineChart component is a complete line chart visualization that combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, PathGroup, and ChartFooter components. It supports multiple series with automatic categorical coloring from DataVis CSS tokens, making it ideal for trend visualization, time series data, and multi-series comparisons.

All tokens come from the CSS cascade — DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew` — both injected at `@layer brand`. No runtime JS token resolver; no `modes` prop.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `133:3117`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=133-3117

## Architecture

```
ChartAccessibility [role="figure", aria-label, aria-describedby, aria-live region]
└── LineChart
    ├── ChartHeader (optional — chartHeader toggle)
    │   ├── ChartTitle
    │   └── ChartSubtitle
    ├── ChartLegend (optional — chartLegend toggle)
    │   └── ChartKey[] (one per series)
    ├── DataDisplay (optional — dataDisplay toggle, id for aria-controls target)
    │   ├── contentWrapperMain
    │   │   ├── mainLabel
    │   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
    │   └── rightBadgeWrapper (Badge + SupportingLabel)
    ├── PathGroup (always rendered)
    │   ├── YAxis (optional) [aria-hidden]
    │   ├── SVG [aria-hidden]
    │   │   └── Paths
    │   │       └── path[] (one per series)
    │   ├── AvgLine (optional — avgLine toggle) [aria-hidden]
    │   │   ├── line (horizontal reference line)
    │   │   └── DataBadge (value label)
    │   ├── hitAreaPaths (individual mode only, transparent overlays)
    │   ├── HoverLine (tracking mode; individual mode on keyboard focus only) [aria-hidden]
    │   │   ├── topHoverDataLabel
    │   │   ├── lineIndicator
    │   │   └── dots[]
    │   ├── dataPointsGroup [role="group", aria-label="Chart data"]
    │   │   └── dataPoint[] (invisible, one per category)
    │   │       └── role="button", aria-roledescription="data point"
    │   └── XAxis (optional)
    └── ChartFooter (optional — chartFooter toggle)
        ├── annotationLeft (source text)
        └── annotationRight (notes text)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { LineChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// or from the component directly:
import { LineChart } from './components/charts/LineChart';
```

## Data Formats

### Canonical Format (Recommended)

```typescript
import type { ChartSeriesDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', series: 'Revenue', value: 100 },
  { category: 'Jan', series: 'Expenses', value: 80 },
  { category: 'Feb', series: 'Revenue', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Feb', series: 'Expenses', value: 85 },
];
```

### Legacy Format (Still Supported)

```typescript
import type { PathGroupData } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: PathGroupData = {
  categories: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar'],
  series: [
    { name: 'Revenue', values: [100, 120, 115] },
    { name: 'Expenses', values: [80, 85, 90] },
  ],
};
```

> **Migration Note**: The component internally normalizes both formats. Prefer canonical `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` for new usage.

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```
LineChart Props
│
├── Layer 2: Parent Props ──────────────── data, seriesOrder, width, height, fullWidth, interactive, animated
│
├── Layer 2: Figma Boolean Toggles ─────── chartHeader, chartLegend, dataDisplay, chartFooter
│
└── Layer 3: Child Component Configs
    ├── chartHeaderConfig ──────────────── { chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue }
    ├── chartLegendConfig ──────────────── { items, interactiveDataHead, size, ... }
    ├── dataDisplayConfig ──────────────── { mode, mainLabelValue, type, size, dataHead, badgeConfig, showBadge, ... }
    ├── pathGroupConfig ────────────────── { yAxis, xAxis, hoverType, dataSort, avgLine, yAxisConfig, xAxisConfig, hoverLineConfig, avgLineConfig, ... }
    └── chartFooterConfig ──────────────── { annotationLeft, annotationLeftValue, annotationRight, annotationRightValue }
```

## Props

### Parent Component Props (Layer 2)

| Prop            | Type                                      | Default     | Description                                                              |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `data`          | `ChartSeriesDataPoint[] \| PathGroupData` | (required)  | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)                                  |
| `seriesOrder`   | `string[]`                                | `undefined` | Order of series names (for canonical format)                             |
| `width`         | `number \| string`                        | `328`       | Width of the chart                                                       |
| `height`        | `number \| string`                        | `400`       | **Total height of the chart.** PathGroup fills remaining space.          |
| `fullWidth`     | `boolean`                                 | `false`     | Stretch chart to 100% of its parent container width                      |
| `interactive`   | `boolean`                                 | `true`      | Enable hover interactivity on lines                                      |
| `animated`      | `boolean`                                 | `false`     | Enable entry animation where paths grow from left to right on first load |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig`                     | `undefined` | Accessibility configuration for screen readers                           |

### Figma Boolean Toggles (Layer 2)

| Prop          | Type      | Default | Description                      |
| ------------- | --------- | ------- | -------------------------------- |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartHeader |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartLegend |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Toggle visibility of DataDisplay |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true`  | Toggle visibility of ChartFooter |

### ChartHeader Config (`chartHeaderConfig`)

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |

### ChartLegend Config (`chartLegendConfig`)

| Prop                         | Type                                                       | Default     | Description                                                                        |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`                      | `ChartLegendItem[]`                                        | `undefined` | Manual legend items — overrides auto-generation from data                          |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<LineChart data={data} />
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  width={400}
  height={280}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Monthly Performance',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Revenue trends for 2024',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    curveStyle: 'Sharp',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeft: true,
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance Department.',
    annotationRight: true,
    annotationRightValue: 'Values in millions.',
  }}
/>
```

### Curved Lines

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Smooth Trend Lines' }}
  pathGroupConfig={{ curveStyle: 'Curved' }}
/>
```

### Single Series (No Legend)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Daily Active Users',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Weekly trend',
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Static Mode)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Trend',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Monthly performance',
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Total revenue',
    showBadge: true,
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '£2,390',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingLabel: true,
      supportingLabelValue: 'Monthly target',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '+23.5%',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

DataDisplay updates dynamically when hovering over the chart:

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Trend' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover to see values',
    showBadge: true,
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
      supportingData: false,
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: false,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode + Custom Formatters)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a point',
    formatHoverLeadValue: (values) => {
      const total = values.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.value, 0);
      return `£${total.toLocaleString()}`;
    },
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (values) => {
      const firstValue = values[0]?.value ?? 0;
      return `${firstValue > 0 ? '+' : ''}${firstValue.toFixed(1)}%`;
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Controlled X-Axis Ticks (Time Series)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Change in Infant Mortality in India',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Per 1,000 live births, 1981–2023',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    yAxis: true,
    yAxisConfig: { tickCount: 4 },
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 8 },
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Average Line

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: {
      formatValue: (value) => `${value.toFixed(1)}%`,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With Threshold Line

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Infant Mortality in India',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Per 1,000 live births, 1981–2023',
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: {
      type: 'threshold',
      thresholdValue: 25,
      formatValue: (value) => `${value}%`,
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Interactive Legend DataHead

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={yearlyData}
  interactive
  chartLegend
  chartLegendConfig={{
    interactiveDataHead: true,
    formatHoverSupportingLabel: (category) => `Year: ${category}`,
    items: [
      {
        type: 'line',
        categoryLabelValue: 'Neonatal mortality rate',
        dataHead: true,
        dataHeadConfig: {
          dataLeadValue: 19,
          supportingData: false,
          supportingLabel: true,
          supportingLabelValue: 'Year: 2023',
          valueFormat: { type: 'number' },
        },
      },
    ],
  }}
  pathGroupConfig={{ curveStyle: 'Curved' }}
/>
```

### With Value Formatting

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={revenueData}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### Broken Axis (Tick Skipper)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={outlierData}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      skippedTicks: [200, 800],
    },
  }}
/>
```

Ticks in the skipped range are hidden, a break indicator appears on the Y-axis, and the D3 scale splits so data outside the gap gets proportionally more visual space.

### Full Width

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Chart' }}
/>
```

### Individual Hover with DataBadge

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    hoverType: 'individual',
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Categorical Hover with DataBadge

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  pathGroupConfig={{
    hoverType: 'categorical',
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Animated Entry

```tsx
<LineChart data={data} animated />
```

### Animated Data Transition

When `animated` is enabled, switching datasets smoothly morphs the line paths and transitions the YAxis tick labels (slide + fade enter/exit). Requires the same number of categories in both datasets for smooth path morphing:

```tsx
const [data, setData] = useState(datasetA);

<LineChart data={data} animated />
<button onClick={() => setData(datasetB)}>Switch to B</button>
```

### Chart Only (No Header/Footer/Legend)

```tsx
<LineChart
  data={data}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  chartLegend={false}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

All tokens resolve through the CSS cascade — no JS token resolver. DataVis categorical colors are emitted by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection` (`@layer brand`); surface/typography/spacing tokens come from `useBrandCSSNew`.

| Property     | CSS Variable                            | Source                      | Description                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Section gap  | `var(--LineChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`| `.container` CSS module     | Gap between chart sections       |
| Series color 1–12 | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` | `generateDataVisCSS`    | Categorical line colors (1–12)   |
| Text         | `var(--Text-High)` / `var(--Text-Medium)` | `useBrandCSSNew`          | Axis labels, legend text         |
| Typography   | `var(--Label-XS-FontSize)` etc.         | `useBrandCSSNew`            | Axis tick and label sizing       |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegendConfig.items` is not provided, the chart automatically generates legend items from the data. Each series gets a name and a CSS custom property color reference (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})`), clamped to the range 1–12.

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total chart height**. PathGroup stretches to fill remaining space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ChartHeader (natural height)            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ChartLegend (natural height)            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ DataDisplay (natural height, optional)  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                         │
│ PathGroup (flex: 1, fills remaining)    │
│   └── AvgLine (optional, overlaid)      │
│                                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ChartFooter (natural height)            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
       ↑                                ↑
       └────── Total height prop ───────┘
```

## Dynamic XAxis Label Padding

When the XAxis is visible, PathGroup automatically measures the first and last displayed tick label widths and applies padding to the content wrapper. This prevents labels centered on the first/last data points from overflowing the chart container. The padding insets both the SVG paths area and XAxis equally, keeping data points aligned with their labels. No configuration is needed — the padding is computed from resolved font tokens and accounts for `formatValue` if provided via `xAxisConfig`.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component positioned between ChartLegend and PathGroup. See **[DataDisplay Integration](./DataDisplayIntegration.md)** for full configuration.

**Note**: In hover mode, formatters receive `(values: { seriesIndex: number; value: number }[], category?: CategoryValue)` — an array of all series values at the hovered X position.

## Accessibility

LineChart implements the full three-layer ARIA accessibility pattern used across all chart types.

### Layer A: ChartAccessibility Wrapper

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides:

- `role="figure"` on the outermost container
- `aria-label` from chart title (or custom `accessibility.ariaLabel`)
- `aria-describedby` linking to an auto-generated natural language summary and a visually-hidden data table
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover/focus announcements

See **[ChartAccessibility.md](./ChartAccessibility.md)** for configuration.

### Layer B: ARIA Live Region (`useChartAccessibility`)

On hover or keyboard focus, LineChart builds an announcement string and passes it through `useChartAccessibility` (which debounces via `useAriaLiveRegion` at 150 ms) to `ChartAccessibility` via `liveText`:

```
"{category}, {Series1Name}: {value1}, {Series2Name}: {value2}"
```

Both mouse hover and keyboard navigation trigger the same announcement pipeline.

### Layer C: Keyboard Navigation (PathGroup)

PathGroup renders invisible focusable data points — one per category — with `useRovingTabIndex`:

- **Tab** into the chart focuses the first data point; **Tab** out leaves (single tab stop)
- **ArrowLeft / ArrowRight** moves between data points (wraps at edges)
- **Home / End** jumps to first / last
- The HoverLine serves as the visible focus indicator (in both tracking and individual modes)

Each data point carries `role="button"`, `aria-roledescription="data point"`, and `aria-label="{category}: {series values}, point N of M"`. When `dataDisplay` is enabled, data points include `aria-controls` linking to the DataDisplay element.

### Decorative Elements

All visual-only elements are marked `aria-hidden="true"`: SVG paths, HoverLine, YAxis, XAxis, AvgLine, ZeroLine.

See **[PathGroup.md](./PathGroup.md) → Accessibility** for full details.
